name: ether-ltm
description: Provenance-disciplined long-term memory: counting-sketch familiarity, append-only event log, verified writes, strict read-outs.

store_path.title: Memory store location
store_path.description: Directory holding ether.db. Leave empty for ~/.claude/ether-ltm/store. Set an absolute path to share one memory across every project. The value is persisted to ~/.claude/ether-ltm/ether.config.json at session start so command-line invocations resolve to the same database.

encoder_model.title: Consolidation encoder model
encoder_model.description: Model alias for the offline consolidation job (haiku, sonnet). Only the consolidator calls a model; hooks never do.
